title: Existence of varying-ring ordinary pullback evaluation
statement: The Lean declaration `lem-sp-varying-ring-module-eval-g-existence` has the displayed unit-normalized ordinary pullback evaluation statement.

proof.text: Construct a right adjoint C_n to evaluation on modules over any ring sheaf A on the vertical sequence site. At (m,V), C_n(M) is the product indexed by PLift(n <= m) of M(V), restricted along A(m,V) -> A(n,V); thus it is zero for m < n. Restrictions are those of M, with the unique compatible inequality. Check functoriality and scalar compatibility by the commuting horizontal/vertical square in the product site. The vertical-slice sheaf criterion reduces gluing and uniqueness to those for M. The unit is horizontal restriction; the counit is evaluation at the reflexive inequality. The two triangle identities are identity restriction maps. Transport this adjunction across evaluation_ring.

Take the mate of moduleEvalP.hom under the two evaluation/right-coextension adjunctions. Its map on every section of every coextension is the identity: the normalized moduleEvalP map is identity, and horizontal restriction in coextension is the identity map on M(V). Hence it is an isomorphism, since the forgetful functors to presheaves and to abelian groups reflect isomorphisms.

Let alpha be the inverse mate of moduleEvalP.hom under moduleAdj and the single-ring pullback/direct-image adjunction. Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv identifies its iterated mate with its conjugate under the composite adjunctions. Step 2 and conjugateEquiv_of_iso imply alpha is invertible. Take d = (asIso alpha).symm. The identity unit_mateEquiv_symm followed by direct image of d.hom gives the required normalized unit equation, since alpha followed by d.hom is identity.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleEvalG_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ d : pull R φ f ⋙ eval R φ X n ≅
        eval R φ Y n ⋙ StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) f,
      ∀ N : Modules R φ Y,
        (eval R φ Y n).map ((moduleAdj R φ f).unit.app N) ≫
          (moduleEvalP R φ f n).hom.app ((pull R φ f).obj N) ≫
          (StrictTower.moduleDirectImage (R n) f).map (d.hom.app N) =
        (Scheme.proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction f (coefficients R Y n)
          (coefficients R X n) (StrictTower.constantRingIso (R n) f)).unit.app
            ((eval R φ Y n).obj N)
